excerpt: An exclusion limit at the 95% confidence level on the mass of the gluino is set at 2.30 TeV for a simplified model containing only a gluino and the lightest neutralino, assuming the latter is massless.
title: Search for squarks and gluinos in final states with jets and missing transverse momentum using 139 fb^-1 of sqrt(s)=13 TeV pp collision data with the ATLAS detector
